main.description: The repository's owner likes an app: a star for it, across its releases. It is of the app's listing (com.pipobscure.bundle.listing), and comes with a post from the same account saying so. The record key is the sha256 of the listing's at:// address in lowercase hex, so an account likes an app once. A like vouches for nothing; nothing installs or refuses by it.

subject.description: The at:// address of the listing of the app liked.

post.description: The post that says so, from the same account.

createdAt.description: When the like was made, by the liker's own clock.
